evidence.llmRationale: Column description explicitly states 'use this to join dim_date for period-level reporting.' Both columns are DATE type with overlapping sample values. dim_date.date_key is the declared grain key.

cafe_sales.product_id column description explicitly states 'Canonical SKU mapped from the till item name; joins to item_master.' Sample values PROD0001–PROD0018 align with item_master.product_id domain (18 SKUs).

d2c_orders.customer_email description states 'links this order to the customer master.' dim_customer.email has uniquenessRatio=1 (1496 distinct values) and identical sample email patterns. d2c_orders distinctCount of 1495 emails aligns with dim_customer's 1496 unique emails.
Column description states 'use to join dim_date for period reporting.' DATE type matches dim_date.date_key grain. Overlapping sample date values confirm shared domain.

Both columns carry Shopify order identifiers with identical #D2C-prefixed format (e.g., #D2C400038). dim_d2c_order is explicitly a dimension table for D2C orders and order_name is its declared unique key. d2c_orders is the fact source.
d2c_orders.product_id column description states 'SKU identifier linking to item_master for product name, category, and brand.' Sample values match the PROD0001–PROD0018 domain of item_master.

dim_customer shares identical hash_key values and source_name (BRONZE_CUSTOMERS_MASTER) with customers_master, confirming it is derived from customers_master with rn=1 filter. dim_customer (1496 rows) is a subset of customers_master (1600 rows); customer_master_id is the shared business key.

dim_d2c_order.customer_email has only 28 distinct values in the sample, all matching the example.com/example.net domain patterns seen in dim_customer.email. dim_customer.email has uniquenessRatio=1, making it a valid join target for customer resolution.
Column description states it is the 'primary key for time-based reporting joins.' DATE type; 421 distinct dates align with dim_date coverage. Standard dimension-to-date-dimension join pattern.
Column description states 'Canonical order date for joining to dim_date for period-based reporting.' DATE type; overlapping sample values (2025-10-04 etc.) fall within dim_date's range.

Column description states 'Canonical SKU; join to item_master for product name, category, and brand.' Sample values match the PROD0001–PROD0018 domain. 18 distinct product_ids match item_master row count exactly.
Column description states 'Unique product/SKU identifier linking to the item master catalog.' Exactly 18 distinct product_ids match item_master row count (18 SKUs). Strong domain alignment.

Column description states 'Links this spend to a specific promotion or campaign.' Sample values PROMO0033, PROMO0145 match promotions.promo_id pattern (PROMO0001–PROMO1000). 835 distinct promo_ids in marketing_spend are within the 1000-row promotions table.

Column description states 'Links each price record to a specific product or SKU.' mrp_master has 18 distinct product_ids across 36 rows (2 price windows per product), perfectly matching item_master's 18 rows.
Column description states 'Transaction date for joining to dim_date for time-based reporting.' DATE type with matching sample date ranges.
Column description states 'Canonical SKU identifier; joins to item_master for product attributes.' Sample values PROD0001, PROD0002 are within item_master domain.
Column description states 'Join key to dim_date for calendar-based month, quarter, and year reporting.' DATE type with overlapping sample values.
Column description states 'Canonical SKU identifier; joins to item_master for product name, category, and brand.' Sample values PROD0001, PROD0003 are within item_master domain.

Column description states 'Identifies a single SKU within the bundle; links to item_master for product details.' Sample values PROD0001, PROD0002, PROD0004, PROD0007, PROD0008 are within item_master domain.

Column description states 'Canonical product/SKU identifier linking this channel code to the master product catalog.' 18 distinct product_ids in product_codes match item_master exactly. product_codes is the mapping/bridge table between channel source codes and item_master.
Column description states 'Canonical product/SKU identifier being ordered on this PO line. Joins to item_master.' 18 distinct product_ids across 1300 PO lines match item_master domain.

Column description explicitly states 'Supplier this PO was raised with. Joins to suppliers.' Sample values SUP0133, SUP0268 match suppliers.supplier_id pattern (SUP0001–SUP1000). 730 distinct supplier_ids are within the 1000-row suppliers table.
Column description states 'Use this column (not the raw timestamp) to join to dim_date for month/quarter/year reporting.' DATE type with overlapping sample values.
Column description states 'Canonical product/SKU identifier. Joins to item_master for product name, category and brand.' Sample values PROD0001, PROD0003 are within item_master domain.
Column description states 'Use this column to join to dim_date for month/quarter/year reporting on returns.' DATE type; 428 distinct dates fall within dim_date coverage.

shipments.order_ref sample values (#D2C400003, #D2C400006, #D2C400007, etc.) match the #D2C-prefixed format of d2c_orders.order_name exactly. shipments.channel_code includes D2C. However, shipments spans multiple channels (PLATFORM, QCOMM, OFFLINE, INTERNATIONAL) so order_ref is polymorphic; this FK applies only for channel_code='D2C' rows.
